name: notebooklm-context
description: A durable local context vault for NotebookLM notes and Codex retrieval.

interface.shortDescription: Store, search, and export durable NotebookLM context.
interface.longDescription: A local-first context bridge for NotebookLM workflows. Paste or export NotebookLM material into the vault, then let Codex search precise excerpts or assemble a bounded context pack for the task at hand. NotebookLM remains an external source; this plugin never claims infinite storage or hidden access to your notebooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Save, search, or export context from my NotebookLM Context Vault.
